answer: Timber-Seeded Slot Lottery. Each epoch, a public verifiable random function output seeds agent task slots; only agents whose identity hash falls below a threshold proportional to their verified work history get assigned. The seed is revealed after registration closes, so attackers cannot precompute favorable identities. To reach the assignment summit, an adversary must fund many fresh identities through real work cycles before each unpredictable draw, and losing identities produce no ripple in rewards. Cost: sustained compute plus full work-history verification per identity, per epoch.
